# TripConnect
> A social platform to find travel companions, plan itineraries, and explore the world together.

TripConnect enables travelers to discover upcoming trips, connect with fellow explorers, align via group chat rooms, and coordinate trip requests and shared travel costs.

## Main Navigation
- [Explore Trips](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/trips): Browse open trips by destination, dates, and budget.
- [Create a Trip](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/create-trip): Organize a new adventure, set group constraints, and accept members.
- [My Dashboard](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/my-trips): Manage trip hosting, pending applicant requests, and joint adventures.

## Information & Support
- [About Us](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/about): Learn about the TripConnect crew and our mission.
- [Safety Guidelines](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/safety): Important guidelines on verifying travel buddies and safe exploration.
- [Help Center](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/support): Support resources, contact forms, and travel FAQs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/privacy): Information on user data protection and privacy.
- [Terms of Service](https://tripconnect-frontend.vercel.app/terms): General rules of conduct and terms for using the platform.
